lines:
Testing the time x treatment
interaction with few clusters

GEE with the Fay-Graubard
correction and a t reference
(N - p degrees of freedom), at any
number of clusters (e.g. patients)
and of occasions

With 2-3 occasions and up to 25
clusters (e.g. patients) it gives no
result in 4-7 datasets out of 10 and
is often conservative: there no method
is both available and calibrated. The
likelihood-ratio test answers more
often but is clearly above 7.5%
false positives in over a third
of those scenarios.
